per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

provider: Hugging Face public Gradio chat Spaces (anonymous API)
category: inference through public Gradio Spaces, anonymous callers

free_tier.stated: ZeroGPU Spaces give an unauthenticated caller 2 minutes of GPU quota a day at low queue priority (5 minutes for a free account); a public Gradio chat Space publishes its API schema with no token
free_tier.notes: each Space defines its own endpoint names, such as /generate on huggingface-projects/llama-2-13b-chat; there is no OpenAI-shaped route and no model id echo

tooling: gradio_client (Client.predict(..., api_name=...)), @gradio/client, or raw HTTP POST+GET as in the Space's generated bash snippet; the schema is at /gradio_api/info on current Gradio and /info on older ones
chaining: pairs with ad hoc scripts; the 2 minutes a day of ZeroGPU quota for an unauthenticated caller is the scarce link

limits.value: 2 minutes of ZeroGPU GPU quota per day for an unauthenticated caller, low queue priority; 5 minutes for a free account; 40 minutes for PRO; the quota resets exactly 24 hours after the first GPU usage; unauthenticated calls use a shared pool with stricter limits

binding_note: the 2 minutes a day of GPU quota binds; a Space on CPU hardware has no such quota stated in the page read

identity_cost.detail: anonymous; a token is optional for public Spaces and improves rate limits, not required; an unauthenticated caller is a documented quota tier (Unauthenticated, 2 minutes, Low queue priority); no token was needed to read /gradio_api/info

reliability_note: a Space can be paused or in an error state, and an older Gradio Space serves its schema at /info rather than /gradio_api/info
confidence_note: route and auth verified by first-party docs, a live OpenAPI spec, and a keyless POST+GET completion on 2026-11-18; quota figures are first-party text, not measured here.

evidence.proved: an unauthenticated caller has 2 minutes of daily ZeroGPU quota at low priority
a free account has 5 minutes a day at medium priority

evidence.quote: Included daily quota resets exactly 24 hours after your first GPU usage.
evidence.proved: the daily quota resets 24 hours after first use
a keyless GET /gradio_api/info answered 200 with a named /generate endpoint on a public chat Space
a keyless POST on 2026-11-10 answered HTTP 405 at the recorded base URL, so the endpoint is not a completion route
every public Gradio Space is callable as an API
evidence.quote: Every Gradio Space on Hugging Face is automatically available as an API endpoint. You can call it from Python, JavaScript, or any HTTP client. If you can use a Space in your browser, you can call it as an API.

evidence.proved: a token is not required for a public Space
evidence.quote: The `Authorization` header is required for private Spaces and gives better rate limits on public Spaces.

evidence.proved: this Space publishes a POST call route and a GET result route
evidence.quote: Output must be fetched from GET /gradio_api/call/generate/{event_id}. Returns an array of 1 elements of the following format: ["output ({'type': {}, 'description': 'any valid json'})"]

interface_detail: two-step Gradio queue API: POST to /gradio_api/call/<api_name> (v2 on Gradio 6.x) returns event_id; GET to /gradio_api/call/<api_name>/<event_id> returns SSE with event: complete. api_name is Space-defined (/generate, /chat); schema at /gradio_api/info or /info; OpenAPI at /gradio_api/openapi.json. No OpenAI-shaped route and no model id echo.
notes: The 405 was a method mismatch on a schema route, not a dead provider; the completion route is two-step and Space-defined.
